passed: Screenshot auto-copy defaults on, can be disabled, persists through toolbar reopen, and an off capture remains saved without copying.

Real wheel scrolling during pointer selection stitches the extended rectangle, auto-copies its exact dimensions, retains original tiles and Northbridge/Alex after a Southridge switch, and restores scroll/styles.
Cancelling an extended drag removes guides and restores the initial page position without a saved image.
Upward scrolling and reverse-direction drags use document coordinates and restore a nonzero starting scroll position.
Holding a drag near the viewport edge scrolls automatically; PageDown extends an active drag and cleanup restores the page.

Pointer tools flatten red arrows, red circles and opaque black redactions into actual PNG pixels; Save & copy uses that image while the original hash remains unchanged. No marks appear until manually drawn.
Replacing an undone edit with a different edit of the same count disables Copy until saved, preventing stale clipboard output.
Precise keyboard crop, undo and Save & copy preserve sequential edit coordinates and use the cropped dimensions.
Changing the selected image in another window clears stale review-sheet pixels and disables printing/export until reopened.
Validated private binary backup retains original images, manual-edit derivatives, hashes, geometry and relationships.
Deleting an edited capture removes every original/derivative blob, clears the open editor and preserves other captures.
Restoring the edited capture from private binary backup retains its selected image hash, manual operations and original case/scan relationships.
Denied folder export retains the edited image; retry exports the current selected derivative after backup restoration.
Concurrent screenshot-copy and folder-export preference updates persist independently.
The compact toolbar retains its direct actions and remembered copy preference with blue controls and no horizontal overflow.
